_source: Arcadis, Quarterly Construction Cost Review Q2 2026 – Hong Kong and China (https://www.arcadis.com/contentassets/51b6ca88731442dfa76230f3426cee33/cnhk-qcc-2026-q2-final-1-2.pdf), transcribed 2026-11-05 by automated text extraction. _basis: HK$/m2 CFA, fixed-price competitive tenders, Q2 2026. CFA measured to outside face of external walls incl. lift shafts, stairs, balconies, plant rooms, tanks. Assumes no basement, flat ground, normal soil. Excludes site formation, external works, land, professional fees, finance and legal costs.
